test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.

Rarely; not often
solution:
The solution is **seldom.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for 'Rarely; not often' is seldom.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss some information about other options.
 
 
• **Habitually - **By way of habit; customarily.

 
 
• ​For example:- she habitually carried a pocket knife.
 
 
 
• Freque**ntly - **Regularly or habitually; often.​
 
 
• ​For example:- they go abroad frequently.
 
 
 
• **Routinely - **As part of a regular procedure rather than for a special reason.
 
 
• ​For example:- large-scale producers routinely vaccinate their birds against the disease.
 
 
 
 

2f8:Tc
